description: This file is a shell script that provides library functions and test utilities for CVS and Git version control system testing within a project. It sources an external test library, performs checks for required tools, and defines functions for setting up test repositories, checking out branches, and comparing directory trees.

methods.name: setup_cvs_test_repository
methods.description: Sets up a CVS test repository by copying from a predefined test directory.

methods.name: test_cvs_co
methods.description: Checks out a specific branch from CVS for testing.

methods.name: test_git_co
methods.description: Checks out a specific branch from Git for testing.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_file
methods.description: Compares a specific file from CVS and Git branch checkouts.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_tree
methods.description: Compares the entire directory trees of CVS and Git branches to ensure they are identical.
